description: The trial-02 model with the transfer amplitude at 2.0 instead of 1.0, which raises the median number of genes the prediction calls significant per perturbation from 39/28/46 to 571/481/560 in contexts A/B/C, and cuts the perturbations calling fewer than ten genes from 6/9/6 out of 20 to 0/0/1 (measured on the official contexts' own control cells). The pre-registered rule capped the amplitude at 1.0 because of a K562 bench artefact; this submission is the same rule without that cap. One second, minor difference: the cis bins were read from a precomputed distance/effect table rather than refitted on the K562 source targets. They are the same measurement and agree with the refitted ones to within 0.02 in natural log (-0.332/-0.231/-0.109/-0.087/-0.036 against -0.328/-0.230/-0.129/-0.080/-0.033).
